'''Phantifox''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Flarevix]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Don't get too impressed by the blooming fireworks. Phantifox is simply clearing away clutter with an elegant yawn."

Phantifox is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A hovering nine-tailed fox with a poppy red and off-white color palette. The tips of its ears are dark red and its legs are grey. Its eyes are slanted open to reveal blue pupils, and it has elliptical eyebrows. Its also has small, blue horns, black paws, and a fluffy chest. Each of its tails have cyan highlights, and it has a marking that resembles cyan-colored lower eyeliner.

Flarevix's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with light blue, off-white with pure white, and cyan with white.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Phantifox don't speak, yet so much is conveyed through those unsettling eyes...' - Tatari Observatorium"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Each tail burns with a flickering flame. When all of Phantifox's tails move in unison, they can weave illusions that leave opponents dazed."
